feed.title: Tesla recalls nearly 3M vehicles over doors that may be difficult to open after crashes
feed.summary: Tesla is recalling nearly 3 million vehicles in China due to a safety concern where doors may be difficult to open after a severe crash if the low-voltage system fails. To address the issue, Tesla will add warning labels and remotely upgrade window-control software to automatically lower windows after an accident.
